current_literal_return_fragments.text:
| Turn | Expression | QL determination and its work | What remains invariant through the change |
|---|---:|---|---|
| **Parent relation** | `−/−` | Bare relationality before the field has been divided into named terms: two present marks held in one expression, the capacity for relation prior to a determinate contrast. It is the unnamed parent of the six, not an additional position among them. | The relation has a condition that cannot appear as one more product of the relation. |
| **#0 Ground** | `0/1` | **Awareness / phenomenon; conscious circumstance.** “I am here; something appears; the appearing is known.” `0` names the open, unobjectifiable fact of awareness; `1` the appearing mark; `/` the relation by which the real becomes readable without being exhausted by its readability. Appearing is in awareness, and awareness is encountered only through appearing; the relation precedes any picture of two completed substances separated by a wall. | The ground is immanent to every mark without becoming another positive mark or a hidden object behind it. |
| **#1 Definition** | `?/!` | **Questioning / asserting; ratio, reckoning, mark.** To ask “what is this?” already asserts that something has appeared stably enough to call for account; to assert “this is” keeps open the question of whether the account runs true. Definition is therefore double: openness to determination and determinative speech. It marks while [remaining answerable to what called for the mark](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md#symbol-answers-to-source). | Every assertion bears the unsettled question that makes it accountable; every genuine question already takes a provisional mark. |
| **#2 Dynamis** | `−/+` | **Withdrawal / extension; force, polarity, Spanda-seed.** The relation becomes energetic: one side functions as reserve, contraction, withholding; the other as issue, release, presentation. The positive is the void’s own self-relation appearing as extension. The poles form a sustained pulse whose moments remain co-present — breath gathers and releases; attention contracts around a word and opens into sense. | The two poles remain one differentiating movement: distinction has force without becoming a war of independent substances. |
| **#3 Pattern** | `X/x` | **Determining-capacity / determinate instance; recurrence.** Capital `X` is the presiding capacity, type, or anything-by-which something can be read; lower-case `x` is its temporal local face. The same letter, in two cases, prevents the instance from being severed from the capacity it manifests. The small `x` also retains multiplication: an instance can recur, compound, and yield “another one of those.” Pattern is where force becomes recognisable as kind, rhythm, memory, and thought. | The local instance makes the general legible but neither contains nor exhausts it. |
| **#4 Context** | `AM/IS` | **First-person presence / third-person sayability; the personed copula.** `AM` is lived “I am”; `IS` is what can be stated as “it is”; the slash is the second-person relation through which they meet. Context is the lived *where* of this encounter — world, body, concern, speech, memory, task — not a neutral container. It is total because nothing appears outside some horizon, and incidental because that horizon does not ordinarily stand forth as one more object. | Knower, means, and known remain one appearing-act without becoming interchangeable: *pramātṛ / pramāṇa / prameya*. |
| **#5 Realisation** | `∞/dx` | **Unbounded depth / infinitesimal differential; horizon and local exactness.** `∞` names the inexhaustible field no finite mark contains. `dx` is no longer merely the instance `x` but the minute difference through which change and local reading become exact. Every appearance is therefore a true local ratio of what exceeds it: precise as relation, partial as expression. The whole is not hidden inside the part; it is present in the way the part runs true to what it cannot enclose. | Exactness never becomes possession. A finite determination remains answerable to the depth that makes it possible. |
| **Return-switch** | `1/0` | The achieved determinate turns toward the ground it presupposes and meets the incomputable rather than an object called “the ground.” The mental cannot find the foundation of the mental, because every act of finding already occurs through it. This is *pratyabhijñā*: recognition, not acquisition. | The limit is generative: `5→0`, the return through ground that renews a further cycle rather than cancelling the determination. |

carrier_return.paragraph: [E2's generated relations](../../../etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md#arbitration-in-crisis) distinguish the consequential decision from its possible usurpation of authority. The [E6 field](../../../etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#canonical-operations) adds what is distributed: finite capacity, criteria, delegated labour, local governing powers and the wider economy sustaining an act. whole_forward.paragraph: The [psychology history](../../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/psychology/DEVELOPMENT.md) **historicises** what a settlement must retain when it returns. Jung’s ego and Self keep different scopes; Neumann’s differentiated centre retains each telling’s geography and time; symbolic transformation changes the interpreter who receives the next image. Resolution-in-Reconciliation carries that changed history rather than restoring an untouched beginning. At register 3, the institutional comparison also returns a limit on transfer: psychic recognition alone neither redistributes coercive power nor supplies an effective appeal, and institutional reform alone does not establish changed affective investment.

branch_forward.paragraph: The [psychology history](../../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/psychology/DEVELOPMENT.md) **historicises** recognition through the distinct scopes of ego, complex and symbolic totality. Its institutional comparison also returns a qualification at register 3: a changed psychic relation does not itself redistribute an office’s power, while an institutional change need not dissolve the affect sustaining it. Anamnesis keeps both histories effective.

carrier_return.paragraph: The [Arbitration whole-field](../../../etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **grounds** the authorial relation carried through this inquiry. Continuity-in-Indeterminacy lets a formation have a history without exhausting its conditions; Criterion-through-Distinction and Delineation-through-Difference make its selecting measure and frame determinate; Arbitration-in-Crisis gives the selection consequence; Con-text-through-Diaphaneity lets excluded conditions bear on it; Resolution-in-Reconciliation returns its achievement with its provenance active. The semantic flowering of the last relation is Anamnesis / Recognition / Return. These generated operations retain their exact offices. The history supplies psychological and institutional witnesses; it does not derive the field from Greek or Latin word histories.

whole_forward.paragraph: The [psychology history](../../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/psychology/DEVELOPMENT.md) **historicises** Account re-entry at register 3 through an image which changes the interpreter and therefore its own later field. carrier_return.paragraph: Their relation **returns-to** [Symbol / Account / Trust](../../../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) through its four exact operations. Symbol answers to source; Account does not replace source; Trust keeps the return route active; Account re-enters source-field. An interpretation can affect the world in which it will next appear convincing. Integrity requires that its effects remain able to alter its criteria. The historical and relational branches of E2, E4 and E5 retain their lexical evidence separately from this psychological continuation.

The next account must give a correction an address at the source, criterion or permission it challenges.

carrier_return.paragraph: The dossier **returns-to** [Count-through-Countenance](../etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD.md#count-through-countenance) through a participant able to answer beyond an attributed profile. A Contribution’s declared basis and an Encounter’s mediated record make acts examinable; they do not certify the participant’s understanding or consent. Count-to-Account must retain the route by which a reply can change its classification, permission or subsequent use.

whole_forward.paragraph: The [O:I dossier](../../dossiers/oi-technical-responsibility.md#oi-source-projection-contribution-route) **extends** Arbitration-in-Crisis, Regard and recollective return at register 3 through a distinction between accepting a contribution and accepting it as source. A Projection may diverge locally or propose a source revision; only the source’s authorised process accepts the latter. Returned evidence can challenge the commission without acquiring ownership merely by entering the shared field.

carrier_return.paragraph: E2's [Arbitration field](../etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** this transition through its complete movement. **Arbitration-in-Crisis → Decision / Hybris** gives an office enough jurisdiction to settle a question and identifies its usurpation when that criterion becomes immune. **Con-text-through-Diaphaneity → Regard** makes the decision's conditions available to what answers it. **Resolution-in-Reconciliation → Anamnesis / Recognition / Return** carries the examined history into another act. The technical responsibility is to let returned difference change the criterion, scope or commission, including a reasoned retention when the evidence warrants it.

whole_forward.paragraph: The [O:I dossier](../../dossiers/oi-technical-responsibility.md#oi-source-and-commission) **extends** the full Fides–Topos–Logos–Nomos–Natio–Credere circuit at register 3. A contribution enters an inherited world of records, translations and permissions; its account identifies a situated author and commission; source acceptance has an authorised office; renewed reliance follows examination. These relations keep their six offices and do not become six product names or one shared historical descent.

carrier_return.paragraph: E3's [Trust / Place / Logos / Nomos / Natio / Credere field](../etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **historicises** the distinct lexical and institutional backgrounds, then **compares** the operative circuit at register3. Prior reliance sustains an undertaking; Topos locates it; Logos articulates its account; Nomos gives rules and offices executable force; Natio keeps inherited belonging and formation visible; Credere renews entrustment after examination. A new participant enters a world already shaped by earlier records, translations and permissions. That inheritance must remain attributable. These six operations are not six product names or one historical descent.

whole_forward.paragraph: The [O:I dossier](../../dossiers/oi-technical-responsibility.md#oi-source-projection-contribution-route) **extends** all four source-circuit operations at register 3. A Projection identifies the source it claims to bear; an account retains local originality and wider dependence; an undertaking leaves recourse and refusal possible; acceptance or divergence changes what a later Projection inherits. The six constructor probes establish bounded record behaviour, not the completed source-return state machine.

carrier_return.paragraph: E4's [Symbol / Account / Trust field](../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **returns-to** the complete source circuit. **Symbol answers to source** when a projection identifies what it claims to bear. **Account does not replace source** when its local original remains answerable in the wider relation. **Trust keeps the return route active** when a bearer undertakes action with recourse and refusal available. **Account re-enters source-field** when the act's effects become conditions of the next encounter. Inspectability supports these relations; it does not perform the undertaking for its participants. E1 keeps the counted participant able to answer beyond the attributed profile, and E5 preserves the respect and difference within every comparison.

whole_forward.paragraph: The [O:I dossier](../../dossiers/oi-technical-responsibility.md#oi-evidence-standing) **extends** the research boundary at register 3 through separately testable contracts, constructors and proposed architectures. Six checks of structured records do not prove source authentication, hosted acceptance or phenomenal localisation. The three-office comparison and five-step return state what an implementation would have to change; their philosophical and source claims keep their independent standing.

carrier_return.paragraph: The dossier **returns-to** [E5’s research boundary](../etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#research-boundary) through the exact scope of each technical comparison. Constructor validation, an acceptance architecture, a three-office proposal and a functional return cycle require different tests. The successful six checks remain valid within their scope while leaving source authentication, learning and phenomenal localisation separately unestablished.

whole_forward.paragraph: The [O:I responsibility dossier](../../dossiers/oi-technical-responsibility.md#oi-source-projection-contribution-route) **extends** delegated labour at register 3 through separately inspectable authorisation, source, projection, contribution, encounter and acceptance. Its six responsibility centres retain their offices alongside the five E6 operations and four Name/Power consequences: expenditure, authorised course, affected other and returned result with costs and correction rights. The direct code probes establish bounded provenance, containment and attributed-record behaviour; they do not authenticate a source, demonstrate learning or certify deployment. Return reaches the responsible authority when a contribution can revise a source claim, criterion or commission while preserving refusal and local ownership.

branch_forward.paragraph: The [O:I dossier](../../dossiers/oi-technical-responsibility.md#oi-commons-and-return) **extends** the returned share at register 3 through source, projection, contribution and acceptance. A shared artifact can change another local field without transferring source ownership; refusal and correction rights remain effective parts of the distribution. The six constructor checks retain their bounded scope beside the wider architectural undertaking.

carrier_return.paragraph: E6's [Apportionment / Economy field](../etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **grounds** the five operational debts: power is finite and apportioned; a criterion distributes shares; delegation carries labour; a commons extends the field of affected participants; planetary computation inherits an economy of material and living conditions. The Name/Power return specifies committed expenditure, authorised course, affected other and returned result with cost and correction rights. These are four productive offices within the existing native field, not reinstated dependencies on the withdrawn `(no)name` or esoteric Power material.

carrier_return.paragraph: An account can change the conditions under which its next statement becomes credible. A profile affects access; access changes conduct; recorded conduct appears to confirm the profile. The profile has acted within its object’s world. Whether it describes that world faithfully remains a further question. This constructed example brings the [Symbol / Account / Trust field](../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md#account-does-not-replace-source) into a precise encounter with Baudrillard: **Account does not replace source**, even where the account participates in producing what it subsequently receives. The field’s further operation, **Account re-enters source-field**, makes that participation consequential.

The lens **returns-to** [E4’s complete field](../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md#account-re-enters-source-field) with four differentiated consequences. **Symbol answers to source:** efficacy leaves fidelity to be tested. **Account does not replace source:** a model’s practical authority retains its dependencies. **Trust keeps the return route active:** disclosure must make correction possible without pretending to guarantee the undertaking. **Account re-enters source-field:** its effects enter the next account together with the possibility of revising its criterion. The three-term field receives a developed participant, not a new lexical primitive.

## Warrant
[[Antikythera Agentworld Brief]] turns agency into a context-bound problem and intensifies the question: an artificial agent cannot be understood solely as an object executing instructions; it inhabits a constructed context-world in which distinctions matter, actions alter future distinctions, and evaluation is internal to a horizon. This is both the historical claim and the methodological demand of diaphaneity; its formal geometry and technical consequences are deliberately withheld.

occurrence.text: The scene's ending carries the trust argument in narrative form, and it must be given whole. The completed apparatus cannot conclude. Detection, capture, proof, judgment — every station succeeds, and the episode stalls: the lovers stay bound, the grievance stays open, and the demand for restitution has no mechanism inside the net for being met; a trap can hold a debtor but cannot make a debt good. Release enters from outside the apparatus, with the one god who does not laugh (8.344). Poseidon offers ἐγγύη — "Loose him; I promise he shall pay all that is right among the immortal gods" (8.346–48) — and, when refused, converts the pledge into personal liability: if Ares flees the debt, "I will myself pay thee" (8.355–56). | **#1 Definition** | `?/!` | **Questioning / asserting; ratio, reckoning, mark.** To ask “what is this?” already asserts that something has appeared stably enough to call for account; to assert “this is” keeps open the question of whether the account runs true. Definition is therefore double: openness to determination and determinative speech. It marks while [remaining answerable to what called for the mark](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md#symbol-answers-to-source). | Every assertion bears the unsettled question that makes it accountable; every genuine question already takes a provisional mark. |
| **#2 Dynamis** | `−/+` | **Withdrawal / extension; force, polarity, Spanda-seed.** The relation becomes energetic: one side functions as reserve, contraction, withholding; the other as issue, release, presentation. The positive is the void’s own self-relation appearing as extension. The poles form a sustained pulse whose moments remain co-present — breath gathers and releases; attention contracts around a word and opens into sense. | The two poles remain one differentiating movement: distinction has force without becoming a war of independent substances. |
| **#3 Pattern** | `X/x` | **Determining-capacity / determinate instance; recurrence.** Capital `X` is the presiding capacity, type, or anything-by-which something can be read; lower-case `x` is its temporal local face. The same letter, in two cases, prevents the instance from being severed from the capacity it manifests. The small `x` also retains multiplication: an instance can recur, compound, and yield “another one of those.” Pattern is where force becomes recognisable as kind, rhythm, memory, and thought. | The local instance makes the general legible but neither contains nor exhausts it. |
| **#4 Context** | `AM/IS` | **First-person presence / third-person sayability; the personed copula.** `AM` is lived “I am”; `IS` is what can be stated as “it is”; the slash is the second-person relation through which they meet. Context is the lived *where* of this encounter — world, body, concern, speech, memory, task — not a neutral container. It is total because nothing appears outside some horizon, and incidental because that horizon does not ordinarily stand forth as one more object. | Knower, means, and known remain one appearing-act without becoming interchangeable: *pramātṛ / pramāṇa / prameya*. |
| **#5 Realisation** | `∞/dx` | **Unbounded depth / infinitesimal differential; horizon and local exactness.** `∞` names the inexhaustible field no finite mark contains. `dx` is no longer merely the instance `x` but the minute difference through which change and local reading become exact. Every appearance is therefore a true local ratio of what exceeds it: precise as relation, partial as expression. The whole is not hidden inside the part; it is present in the way the part runs true to what it cannot enclose. | Exactness never becomes possession. A finite determination remains answerable to the depth that makes it possible. |
| **Return-switch** | `1/0` | The achieved determinate turns toward the ground it presupposes and meets the incomputable rather than an object called “the ground.” The mental cannot find the foundation of the mental, because every act of finding already occurs through it. This is *pratyabhijñā*: recognition, not acquisition. | The limit is generative: `5→0`, the return through ground that renews a further cycle rather than cancelling the determination. |

occurrence.text: The image gathers two recoveries. The first belongs to the word technē, in the genealogy Heidegger recovered: technē "linked with the word epistēmē," both "names for knowing in the widest sense"; technē belonging "to bringing-forth, to poiēsis"; "it is as revealing, and not as manufacturing, that technē is a bringing-forth" (*QCT*, pp. 12–13). The definition of poiēsis he quotes is Diotima's, from *Symposium* 205b — "every occasion for whatever passes over and goes forward into presencing from that which is not presencing is poiēsis" — and the same banquet gives the essay its symbolon in Aristophanes' speech: emission and return seated at one table from the beginning (the connection is the essay's own, **Argued**). An attunement instrument is technē in this recovered sense — a made thing whose making reveals, coordinating cycles it does not own for an observer it does not replace — which is the mechanism's exact difference from the net of §2 · #3: both are consummate craft; one renders cycles mutually readable for a situated observer, the other renders persons capturable for a convened audience.

An image becomes consequential through the significance gathered around it. In the agentworld the image has precise technical names: the persona presented to a user, the profile trained on a user, the embedding that stands for a person inside a model, the shadow-self acting on a user's behalf. Valuation accumulates through use — trust in the brief's systems sense, reliance on well-modeled behaviour ([q030](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q030)), together with the affection a parasocial relation adds and the standing a double acquires in the world. Possession is the office change: what the image represents must now answer to the image. [A20](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) grounds the three-step relation; [A19′](A19-prime-The-Local-Regime.md) grounds the local regime whose principal medium this is.

The loop in the title is the return route. So long as the source can revise its own image — correct the profile, contest the persona's precedent, withdraw the double's mandate — the image remains a representation answering through a living route to what it represents. Possession is the closure of that route, and this argument carries a name for the closed construction in the essay's own vocabulary: operational truth — the profile continuing to act as its source while the source has changed, the image's operational force passing as the truth of the person. The brief describes the parts and never names the relation; the naming is the essay's work.

Distinctions promoted into design must yield some inspectable consequence in operation, or they are decoration. [A33 — Epistemic Cultivation / Operational Parity](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity.md) established the discipline: when a philosophical or formal distinction is used to justify a technical feature, the claimed difference must have an identifiable operational locus and a consequence that inspection or a meaningful test can discriminate. ## #0

Every synthetic utterance descends from an inherited human world. The weights were trained on human language and human records; the harness runs on human infrastructure; the persona speaks a human tongue. The brief gives that inheritance its most exact face: [very soon most of the speakers of human languages won't be human](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q036), and the proposed [allolinguistics](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q037) would study the feedback of that turn "on our own language, and thus indirectly on our own thought." The allolinguistic future is the inheritance compounding: human speech nourishing the agents that reshape human speech.

[A35 — Compassion / Sensitivity to Origins / Epi-Logos as Vocation](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md) **grounds** the operation re-sited here: [[Compassion / Sensitivity to Origins]] — the determination returns to its genesis, relations, wounds, exclusions and purposes with an orientation that does not consume them. A34′ stated the order of dependence beneath the relay; this page follows the return's manner, which decides whether the relay nourishes what it draws from.

current_literal_forward_fragments.text: Trust is already operative before the first completed account. A witness relies on memory and language; a reader relies on a legible record; a participant relies on another's capacity to answer. The account can examine and strengthen these dependencies without standing outside all of them at once. [A01, faithful definition](../../arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) **grounds** the positive duty: make the determination and keep its determining act visible. [A23, trust under formal limit](../../arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) **grounds** the committed relation in which such knowledge is possible. E4 gives those arguments a differentiated lexical and operational field through which their determinations can travel.

[A23](../../arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) **extends** the committed relation precisely: evidence can establish what occurred and make an obligation inspectable; entrusting someone to bear that obligation remains an act. [C48](../../concepts/C48-Trust-Faith-under-Formal-Limit.md) **defines** the distinctions among already enacted dependence, knowledge's finite achievement, belief's stabilised orientation and faith's conscious continuation. Formal limitation does not annul a commitment whenever it becomes difficult. Actual harm, withdrawal and refusal remain consequential; calling a relation trust cannot oblige submission to an abusive office.

At evidence register 3, [the whole Ares–Aphrodite relation](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/hellenic/ares-aphrodite-hephaestus-poseidon/WHOLE.md#ares-guarantee-release) **figures** the difference between an account of capture and the undertaking which makes release possible; [A23](../../arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) and [A25](../../arguments/A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) return its named bearer of liability. [the complete Apollo–Eros–Daphne–Peneus whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/roman-latin/apollo-eros-daphne-peneus/WHOLE.md#apollo-appropriation-after-withdrawal) **figures** a different consequence: an emblem can remain culturally effective after the failed encounter, so [A20](../../arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) returns efficacy to source-answerability.
